title: Young Women Riding Horses at Ranch, 1950s Deckled Edge B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1950s black-and-white snapshot capturing two young women mounted on saddled horses in an open outdoor paddock or corral under bright sunlight. A young boy in a striped shirt stands nearby behind one of the horses. The girl in the foreground wears a short-sleeved top, dark shorts or pedal pushers, and white socks with canvas shoes, typical of mid-20th-century casual leisure attire. Suburban or ranch-style homes, utility poles, and post-and-rail fencing form the background setting.
